import os, pathlib, urllib.request, zipfile
url='https://rigeo.sgb.gov.br/bitstreams/48206607-8c4f-4890-80c2-edfae1b4e098/download'
out=pathlib.Path(r'C:\mcp-blender\vendor\geodata\produtos_mde_salvador_ba.zip')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
if not out.exists() or out.stat().st_size < 100_000_000:
    part=out.with_suffix('.zip.part')
    req=urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as r, open(part,'wb') as f:
        total=int(r.headers.get('Content-Length') or 0)
        done=0
        while True:
            chunk=r.read(8*1024*1024)
            if not chunk: break
            f.write(chunk); done += len(chunk)
    os.replace(part,out)
print('DOWNLOADED',out, out.stat().st_size)
with zipfile.ZipFile(out,'r') as z:
    infos=z.infolist()
    print('ZIP_ENTRIES',len(infos))
    for i in infos:
        n=i.filename
        if n.lower().endswith(('.tif','.tiff','.asc','.xyz','.img','.grd','.shp','.prj','.xml','.txt')):
            print(n, i.file_size)
